visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with short black hair and a woman in a white fluffy animal-eared hoodie lie side by side on a bed. The man looks up thoughtfully while the woman speaks with a pouty expression. Large yellow subtitles appear at the bottom. (2) A close-up shot of a bed overflowing with various plush toys, including a red octopus, a shark, a giraffe, and several seals. (3) The man is shown again on the bed, now visibly squeezed into a tiny space between two large stacks of stuffed animals, looking directly at the camera with a resigned expression. (4) In a well-lit indoor room with bookshelves and framed pictures, the man stands and speaks to the woman. He wears a white t-shirt with a rainbow graphic. (5) The woman holds a black and white penguin plushie to her chest, looking sadly at the camera before transitioning into an energetic, shouting expression. (6) The woman playfully attacks the man on the bed using the penguin plushie. They both laugh, and the camera shakes slightly during the playful movement. Posters of space and nature are visible on the white wall behind them.
